name: LTXV scheduler
plain: LTX Video schedule: a linear ramp pushed through the Flux-style exponential shift, with μ from token count. An optional stretch rescales 1−σ so the last nonzero sigma lands exactly on terminal. Tokens come from the latent's spatial and temporal size, or 4096 with no latent.
math:
tokens = ∏ latent.shape[2:] (or 4096).
μ = tokens·m + b; m = (max_shift−base_shift)/(4096−1024), b = base_shift − m·1024.
σ_i = e^μ/(e^μ + (1/u_i − 1)), u=linspace(1,0,steps+1), keeping 0 at u=0.
Stretch: z=1−σ (nonzero); s=z_last/(1−terminal); σ'=1−z/s.

props.shape: linear ramp, exponential shift, optional stretch to terminal
